item.title: Birrundudu Drawings
item.description: In 1945, sixteen Aboriginal men working at Birrundudu station created 810 crayon drawings. Using this unfamiliar medium, the men documented their extensive knowledge of Country, ancestral creation, history, and ceremonies of the region.
